app.name: AcuDx
app.eduDisclaimer: For education only. Not for real patient care.

home.title: Rehearse the case before the case rehearses you.
home.subtitle: Text-first emergency-medicine roleplay with structured, evidence-anchored feedback and a calibration mirror.
home.welcomeSub: Pick up an emergency-medicine case, or review where your calibration is trending.
home.recommendedSub: Emergency-medicine cases matched to where you are now.
home.recentSub: Formative notes from your last few encounters.
home.noPublicLeaderboard: Private by design. No public leaderboard.

empty.casesBody: New emergency-medicine cases are added regularly. Check back soon.
empty.feedbackBody: Finish your first encounter to see formative feedback here.

progress.title: Mastery, not a scoreboard
progress.subtitle: Everything here rewards closing your gaps and tightening your calibration. It is private, formative, and yours alone.

level.valueText: {{percent}}% of the way to the next level
level.remaining: {{xp}} XP to go, earned only by improving

streak.freezes: {{left}} of {{total}} freezes left. A rough week will not break your streak.
streak.graceNote: Yesterday was covered by a grace day. No pressure to catch up all at once.

mastery.heading: Mastery map
mastery.subtitle: Where you stand across the six competency domains, shown as bands with the change since last week.
mastery.notEnough: Not enough reliable evidence yet ({{count}} encounters). Keep practising to unlock a band.

delta.up: Up a band since last week
delta.down: Down a band since last week

epa.heading: Entrustable activities
epa.subtitle: Key EPAs and the level of supervision you have earned. Entrusted means you can practise these with distant supervision.

trajectory.heading: Calibration trajectory
trajectory.subtitle: Your confidence-performance gap and Brier score over recent sessions. Both trending down is the goal.
trajectory.empty: Not enough sessions yet to plot a trajectory.

badges.heading: Milestones
badges.subtitle: Identity milestones for competency and entrusted activities. Earned by what you demonstrated, never by volume.

review.heading: Spaced review
review.subtitle: Cards scheduled from your past gaps, spaced so each one returns just before you would forget it. Every card is cited.

cohort.heading: Compare on improvement
cohort.explainer: An optional, anonymised cohort view ranked only on how much you have improved, never on raw performance. No names, no global ranking.
cohort.offNote: Off by default. Turn this on to see your improvement against an anonymised cohort. You can turn it off at any time.
cohort.percentileNote: Among {{size}} anonymised learners. Improvement only, never competence.

start.title: Set up your encounter
start.subtitle: A few choices shape the case, your role, and how much the app helps. You can change every setting later.

mode.heading: How do you want to practice?
mode.hint: Solo runs everything with AI. Rooms and observing bring other people into the encounter.

role.heading: Which role will you play?
role.hint: Your role changes the case, the scope of your actions, and what you are scored on.

complaint.heading: What should the patient present with?
complaint.hint: Pick a chief complaint, or let the app choose one for you.

tune.heading: Tune the session
tune.hint: Set the challenge, confirm your language, and choose whether guidance starts on.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.forgiveness: Lower levels add scaffolding and never penalise naive questions.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The whole encounter runs in this language.

guidance.label: Guidance
guidance.hint: Cited Socratic hints when you pause. Nothing is graded on them.

start.summary: You will run a {{difficulty}} {{complaint}} case as the {{role}}.
start.eduNote: For education only. Synthetic patients. Not for real patient care.

cases.title: Browse and generate cases
cases.subtitle: Start from a curated case or generate an endless supply of new synthetic patients. Every case is grounded in guidelines and built to teach.
cases.eduNote: For education only. Synthetic patients. Not for real patient care.

generate.heading: Generate a case
generate.hint: Build a fresh synthetic patient on demand. The generator draws by prevalence and teaching value, then checks the case for internal consistency before adding it.
generate.unlimited: New each time and never repeating. Generated cases are added to the top of the library.

results.label: Cases
results.empty: No cases match these filters yet. Adjust the filters or generate a new case.

encounter.title: Encounter
encounter.composerPlaceholder: Type to the patient, or order a test...
encounter.sendHint: Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.abstained: No grounded guidance for this step yet.

sim.full: Simulation. Synthetic patient. For education only.

storyboard.label: Storyboard
storyboard.problemsEmpty: No problems added yet. Build them in A and P.
storyboard.medsEmpty: Ask about medications and past history to populate this.

clock.title: Encounter clock
clock.label: Encounter clock, minutes and seconds elapsed

chartReview.triageBody: {{age}}-year-old presenting with {{complaint}}. Placed on the monitor at arrival.
chartReview.timelineEmpty: Your actions will appear here in order as you work the chart.

interview.empty: Start the history: choose a question below and the patient will answer. Nothing is shown until you ask.
interview.noInfo: I am not sure how to answer that.
interview.askHint: Each question reveals only what you ask for.
interview.examHint: Request a maneuver to reveal the finding.
interview.extractionNote: History and exam are extracted here. Objective data is ordered in the Orders tab.

flowsheet.title: Nursing flowsheet
flowsheet.subtitle: Vital signs recorded over time.
flowsheet.caption: Vital signs over the encounter, with status for each reading

orders.footnote: Results return after a short simulated turnaround. Check the Results tab.
orders.expectedNote: {{count}} indicated orders are expected for this case.

results.none: No results yet. Place an order to see results here.
results.labsCaption: Laboratory results with reference ranges and abnormal flags

ap.differentialEmpty: Add candidates from the picker to build your differential.
ap.planPlaceholder: Write your management and disposition plan...

newCase.randomHint: Sampled from ICD/DSM by prevalence and teaching value.

table.caption: Vital signs, current reading and status

lobby.title: Team rooms
lobby.subtitle: Practice real clinical teamwork: several people in one live encounter, each a distinct role, with AI filling any empty seats. A solo run is just the one-person case.
lobby.empty: No open rooms right now. Create one to start a team drill.
lobby.prodNote: Team rooms bring several people into one shared encounter in real time. Text rooms are the accessible baseline; voice and 3D are premium features.

create.title: Create a room
create.subtitle: Pick a case and choose which roles are human seats. The rest are backfilled by AI.
create.rolesHint: Turn a role on for a human seat, or leave it off to let AI play it.
create.backfillHint: AI participants join as first-class team members and are always labelled.

inroom.aiNote: AI-held seats are clearly labelled and take turns visibly. They are never scored as humans in the debrief.
inroom.canOrderNote: You can place orders for this encounter. Confirm safety checks before you commit.
inroom.cannotOrderNote: This role cannot place orders directly. You can prompt the doctor; your request is logged as assessment evidence, so it is not lost if it goes unanswered.
inroom.floorNote: Closed-loop communication is scored. Orders are read back with the drug and dose as locked tokens.

debrief.label: Team debrief
debrief.title: Debrief
debrief.subtitle: Your individual marks and the team's clinical marks are kept separate, so a strong lead on a weak team, or the reverse, is clear.
debrief.noHat: You did not wear the team-lead hat this run, so there are no individual leadership marks.
debrief.note: AI-held roles are labelled and never scored as humans. Full calibration and the dual-axis breakdown appear in your feedback.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.subtitle: Dual-axis, evidence-anchored, band-only. No hidden score.
feedback.safetyStripClean: No safety-critical misses in this encounter.

remediation.note: Nothing here is graded or ranked. It feeds your practice queue.

feedback.withheld: Not enough reliability to score this yet.

process.heading: Process and timing
process.subtitle: What was done, in what order, and how fast, measured against guideline expectations and cited.
process.criticalActionsNote: Each action is measured against its guideline target and cited, whether on time or not.
process.criticalActionTitle: Time-critical action. A miss is surfaced separately.

timing.takenAnchor: Ordered at {{taken}} min; target within {{target}} min

safety.cleanNote: Time-critical actions and safety checks were completed this encounter.

calibration.title: Confidence vs performance
calibration.subtitle: How well your confidence matches your performance. This is a skill you can train.
calibration.insufficient: Not enough evidence yet to plot this.
calibration.explainer: Each dot is one domain. Dots on the dashed line mean your confidence matched your performance. This is a trainable skill, not a grade.

institution.title: Cohort competency dashboard
institution.subtitle: How your emergency-medicine cohort is progressing, where the recurring gaps are, and the evidence you need for accreditation.
institution.privacyBanner: Aggregate and role-gated. A learner's private calibration is never shown here.

kpi.competenceRiseHint: Measured gain on a held-out case

heatmap.heading: Cohort competency heatmap
heatmap.headingSub: Each learner across the six competency domains, banded and drillable to the evidence span.
heatmap.title: Learners by domain
heatmap.subtitle: Bands are reliability-gated. Select a learner or cell to drill down to the encounter and its evidence span.
heatmap.tableCaption: Competency band for each learner across the six domains, with a drill-down affordance per cell.
heatmap.tableEquivCaption: Table equivalent of the competency heatmap: competency band for each learner across the six domains.
heatmap.roleGatedNote: Role-gated view: the dean sees banded competency and can drill to the grader's evidence span, but never a learner's private calibration plot.
heatmap.cellWithheldAria: {{learner}}, {{domain}}: band withheld, not enough reliable evidence yet.
heatmap.drillPath: Cohort to section to learner to encounter to evidence span. Widest gap: {{domain}}.
heatmap.evidenceCaption: Verbatim evidence span the grader used, in the learner's own language.
heatmap.frameworkTip: Crosswalk view only. Switching frameworks re-maps the same evidence; it never re-grades.

remediation.heading: At-risk and remediation
remediation.headingSub: The closed loop: detect, diagnose, prescribe, re-assess, document. Each record is exportable.

trigger.safety: Surfaced by recurring safety-critical misses in suspected acute coronary syndrome.
trigger.stalled: Surfaced by stalled competency across several encounters.

calibration.heading: Aggregate calibration
calibration.headingSub: Where the cohort is systematically over or under-confident, read as a curriculum signal.
calibration.title: Systematic miscalibration by topic
calibration.subtitle: A curriculum diagnostic at the cohort level. Overconfidence on a clinical topic is a teaching priority.
calibration.headline: Curriculum signal
calibration.headlineBody: The cohort is systematically overconfident on {{topic}}, by {{points}} points. Prioritise it in the next block.
calibration.privacyNote: Aggregate only. No individual learner's calibration is exposed here (calibration is never ranked).

export.heading: Accreditation export
export.headingSub: One click, framework-tagged, de-identified, with the crosswalk version stamped.
export.title: Build a de-identified export
export.subtitle: Tag the export to your accreditation frameworks. The evidence is crosswalked, never re-graded.
export.blocked: Include the fairness audit to generate the export.

fairness.heading: Fairness audit
fairness.headingSub: Required, not optional. Score distributions broken out by language subgroup, TR against EN.
fairness.title: Language subgroup fairness
fairness.subtitle: Broken out for the Turkish-primary and English-primary subgroups.
fairness.invariant: The clinical axis must not track language. Accent and second-language form never score, so clinical bands should match across subgroups.
fairness.tableCaption: Fairness metrics for the Turkish-primary and English-primary subgroups, with a within-tolerance status.
fairness.footnote: The higher Turkish speech-to-text fallback rate is a voice-path property, shown transparently. It never feeds a competence score.

common.errorBody: We could not load this. Your transcript is safe.
common.emptyEncounters: No encounters yet. Start your first case.

authoring.title: From blueprint to a signed, versioned case
authoring.subtitle: AI drafts the case, a credentialed clinician stays authoritative. Every clinical fact is grounded, cited, and locked before a learner ever sees it.
authoring.aiHumanNote: AI drafts. A named clinician reviews, edits, and signs off. The sign-off gate is enforced in code, not policy.
authoring.eduNote: All patients are synthetic and every case is for education only. Not for real patient care.

pipeline.heading: The authoring pipeline
pipeline.headingSub: Six stages from a case blueprint to a monitored, published case. AI drafts the middle; the clinician holds the pen at every gate that matters.

blueprint.title: Blueprint
blueprint.desc: Complaint, objectives, level, country and council, locales.

draft.title: AI draft
draft.desc: Persona, case state, vitals drivers, rubric items and anchors.

review.title: Expert review and lock
review.desc: Facts edited, grounded, cited, and locked by a clinician.

psychometric.title: Peer and psychometric
psychometric.desc: Peer endorsement, inter-rater agreement, difficulty, DIF check.

publish.title: Publish and version
publish.desc: Sign-off freezes the case and rubric with version hashes.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.desc: Freshness watch flags cited-guideline drift for re-review.

blueprint.heading: Case blueprint
blueprint.headingSub: The brief the AI drafted from. Country and council are independent of learning locale.

editor.heading: Expert review and lock
editor.headingSub: The human-authoritative core. AI-drafted facts on the left with provenance; the rubric and its six-domain coverage on the right. A fact cannot reach a learner until it is cited and locked.
editor.factsSub: Every clinical claim carries a cited, versioned guideline reference and a lock state. An ungrounded claim cannot be locked.
editor.rubricSub: Each item has behavioural anchors, a weight, a domain, and a safety flag. The domain enum is fixed.
editor.flaggedNote: This claim could not be grounded to a cited source. It is held for review and blocks publish until resolved.

psychometric.heading: Peer and psychometric pre-flight
psychometric.sub: Item-quality signals a reviewer weighs before sign-off. The pilot cohort is de-identified and small; none of this is a public metric.

signoff.sectionSub: The hard gate: publish is disabled until every fact is grounded and a credentialed clinician co-signs. Sign-off freezes the case and rubric with version hashes.
signoff.heading: Publish readiness
signoff.sub: Review the pre-flight, the per-locale status, the fact-lock state, and the version hashes before the credentialed clinician co-signs.
signoff.localeNote: A case is only offered in a locale whose content and rubric passed clinician-fluent review. Turkish can trail English until a Turkish reviewer signs off.
signoff.factsClear: All clinical facts are grounded and locked.
signoff.factsBlocked: {{count}} fact is not yet grounded and locked. Resolve it before publish.
signoff.factsBlocked_other: {{count}} facts are not yet grounded and locked. Resolve them before publish.
signoff.cosignLabel: I am the credentialed clinician of record and I approve this case for publication.
signoff.signedConfirmation: Co-signed by {{name}}. Case and rubric frozen.
signoff.modelProvenance: Drafted by AI and independently cross-checked for consistency. No commercial vendor is named.
signoff.blockedByFacts: Publish is blocked until every clinical fact is grounded and locked.
signoff.blockedByCosign: Publish is blocked until the credentialed clinician co-signs.

monitor.heading: Published and monitored
monitor.headingSub: Your published cases with version hashes and last-reviewed dates. A guideline change flags a case for re-review; nothing auto-publishes and nothing is auto-rewritten.

hero.title: Rehearse the case before the case rehearses you.
hero.subtitle: A text-first clinical simulator: work a synthetic patient in an EHR, get evidence-anchored feedback, and see your calibration.
hero.bilingualNote: First-class in Turkish and English, text and voice.

panelRow.chat: Interview a synthetic patient in the EHR

phases.heading: Walk every phase of the product
phases.headingSub: Each phase opens its own screen. Start anywhere, or take the guided tour from the top bar.

roleplay.title: Roleplay and EHR
roleplay.body: Interview a synthetic patient, order tests, and read a live vitals monitor inside a real EHR shell.

cases.title: Dynamic cases
cases.body: Cases are generated on demand from ICD and DSM, so a cohort can never memorise the bank.

guidance.title: Cited guidance
guidance.body: Socratic hints, grounded and cited, that never hand over the answer and never block the encounter.

feedback.title: Calibration feedback
feedback.body: Dual-axis, banded feedback with a private calibration mirror and safety-critical misses surfaced always.

rooms.title: Multiplayer rooms
rooms.body: Run a shared case across doctor, nurse, and paramedic roles over one authoritative patient state.

progress.title: Progress
progress.body: Track competence over time as trainable, banded skill, with no numeric score and no public leaderboard.

institution.title: Institution analytics
institution.body: A dean sees cohort competency, the remediation loop, and a fairness audit, aggregate and role-gated.

sovereign.title: Sovereign and self-hosted
sovereign.body: Self-hosted, with human-authoritative case authoring and full data sovereignty. No commercial vendor lock-in.

closing.heading: Take the guided tour
closing.body: Walk all nine screens in order to see every phase, from a first encounter through calibration feedback to the institution dashboard.
closing.note: Currently in {{lang}}. Switch language any time from the top bar.

tour.title: Walk the product
tour.description: Step through every phase in order, or jump to any screen.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.hint: The product overview and entry point.

encounter.hint: Work a synthetic patient in the EHR.
